answer_2.quote: Evaluation in QA-SRL involves, for each verb, aligning its predicted argument spans to a reference set of arguments, and evaluating question equivalence, i.e., whether predicted and gold questions for aligned spans correspond to the same semantic role.

answer_4.quote: We first release a preliminary crowd-wide annotation round, and then contact workers who exhibit reasonable performance. They are asked to review our short guidelines, which highlight a few subtle aspects, and then annotate two qualification rounds, of 15 predicates each.
answer_4.guideline: guidelines highlight a few subtle aspects
